title: Sorted slices: merge, dedupe, intersect
hints: Two pointers: `i` indexes `a`, `j` indexes `b`. Compare `a[i]` with `b[j]` and advance only the side you consumed. Because both are sorted, you never need to look back.

`MergeSorted`: `out := make([]int, 0, len(a)+len(b))`; loop while both have elements, appending the smaller; afterwards append the leftovers `a[i:]...` and `b[j:]...`. `Dedupe`: `out := s[:0]` and append `v` only when `out` is empty or `v != out[len(out)-1]`.

`Intersect`: use a `switch` with `a[i] < b[j]` (i++), `a[i] > b[j]` (j++) and `default` (equal): append the value once, then skip forward on both sides while the elements still equal that value. Start from `var out []int` so you never write into `a` or `b`.
